profile.headline: Expedia
profile.summary:
Working knowledge in HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, Angular 2, NodeJS, PHP, Javascript, MySQL, ActionScript and a very basic level of .Net.

Experience with  Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Flash, Espresso, Adobe Illustrator, Excel, Word, Adobe Premiere, Adobe After Effects, Animation Master, Macromedia Dreamweaver, Kronos TImekeeper, Soft Grocer.

CMS knowledge using WordPress, Drupal, MessageGears, Tumblr and Blogger.

Fluent Spanish speaker.

positions.title: Web Developer/Designer
positions.description: Designed by me and developed using Angular 2, HTML5, CSS3 and jQuery.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Writing  custom scripts for Google AdWords to assist the marketing team track spending more efficiently.

I was responsible for coding tools to help ad tracking across over 200 websites amongst other internal tools.

I was part of a team that would update and maintain the same 200+ websites on a routine basis.

I was responsible for the  creation of various Wordpress themes either using custom code or one of several tools available.

iPartnerMedia’s latest promotional video was animated and edited by myself using After Effects.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
I helped port their email marketing campaigns from ExactTarget to MessageGears. Along porting over the code between systems I had to comb through the HTML and CSS for any campaigns code, old and new, for compatibility on all popular email clients.  If errors were found it was up to me to fix the broken code.

I developed tools to improve the development time and automate a portion of the work for large marketing campaigns translated into over 20 languages using NodeJS.

I worked on their tool Email Builder and helped reach code parity for the several different versions and added a host of features to both improve current features and add new ones.  This was all done with HTML5 CSS3, Javascript and .Net.

I helped update a delivery research tool, written in .Net, to be able to load data from MessageGears instead of ExactTarget.

positions.title: Writer, Designer, Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed and maintain six year old website dedicated to movie reviews. 

Developed, designed and implemented multiple custom themes for Drupal over its lifetime using HTML5, CSS3 and PHP.

Developed an extensive account system to handle guest bloggers and content governance. 

I took charge of security for the website through to its resolution when being attacked by bots.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Developed, designed and maintain a photography website using Wordpress.

Developed using responsive design, AngularJS, HTML5, CSS3, PHP and MySQL.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Leading execution of website using WordPress, HTML5, PHP, Javascript, jQuery and CSS3.

Developed custom-built web pages, various landing pages and image editing for ads and/or the website.  All of these used HTML5, CSS3, Javascript and jQuery. 

I’m also part of the planning committee and am a frequent panelist. The website was build using WordPress.  It also has elements of responsive design using CSS3, jQuery and Javascript.  

It features a custom theme and custom WordPress plugin I developed specifically for the website to facilitate adding new guests to the guest page and fetching actor biographies from TheMovieDB.org.

positions.title: Cinematographer, Editor
positions.description: Responsible for the photography and editing of "Monsters" a feature  film.  I had heavy involvement with the production and post production process.

positions.title: Assistant Programer
positions.description: Responsible for judging film submissions, actively seeking out films for the festival and editing the trailers advertising the film festivals many entries.

positions.title: Associate Web Developer
positions.description:
Lead developer prototyping applications and managing development with contracted international engineering team through implementation using jQuery. 

I developed the Design Center application using jQuery, HTML5, CSS3 and AJAX which emulates a Photoshop-like experience in the browser, which allowed the creation of emailable and PDF generated ads.

I developed various custom website templates off the designer’s Photoshop files using HTML5 and CSS3.

Developed a, now trademarked, Flash application named the Logoizer. It’s used to place custom logos that can be emailed from the website itself.  It was developed using ActionScript 2.0 along with HTML and CSS. 

I designed, planned and implemented custom Ecommerce product and landing pages to meet the growing demands of the business. 

Took over control of vendor developed and hosted website. Managed process of migrating aging technology, translating eight years of development investment into a faster experience across the country and improved user experience. Assuming control over website increased conversions by 200% and attracted new customers globally.

positions.title: Front and Back End Web Developer, Designer
positions.description:
Custom built CMS in PHP from the ground up and designed the site using HTML,CSS3 and MYSQL and Bootstrap.

I designed the site and created a custom CMS featuring integration with themoviedb.com's movie database.

positions.title: Javascript/Flash Developer
positions.description:
Coded three versions of the Code Generator for their website.  One in Flash and two using Javascript.

The Code Generator facilitated the customer in generating an order number that worked together as there were many of the harness components didn't fit together.

positions.title: Game Tester
positions.description: Quality assurance, bug testing, hardware testing.

positions.title: Store Accounting Coordinator
positions.description: Payroll, accounting, human resources,  deposits and management responsibilities.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description: Opening/closing, making schedules, delegating responsibilities, customer service, stock, processing shipments and keeping paperwork neat and up-to-date.

honors.title: Best Adaptation
honors.description: "The Shunned House" which I edited and did sound design for won best adaptation at the H.P. Lovecraft Film Festival.
honors.issuer: Issued by H.P. Lovecraft Film Festival · Sep 2012

honors.title: Photography
honors.description: Over 43 awards for my photography in just over a year.
